mentions.name: lowlow.bot
mentions.description: This service tracks price changes on any website, offering a weekly digest email, a list of tracked items, and a price history chart. It alerts users when tracked products go on sale or come back in stock, useful for waiting on big purchases and stocking up on non-perishable essentials. Inspired by camelcamelcamel but not limited to Amazon.
mentions.problem: Existing price trackers like camelcamelcamel only work for Amazon; the author wanted price tracking that works on any website.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building https://lowlow.bot, it tracks price changes on any website. I was inspired by https://camelcamelcamel.com, but wanted something that worked for more than just Amazon.
